cohort_total_n_excerpt: in a cohort study of 47,843 US men (1986-1998)

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Compared with abstainers, risk was greatest among men who consumed an average of > or = 105 g/week but who drank on only 1-2 days per week (HR = 1.64, 95% CI: 1.13, 2.38).
estimate_classifications.reason: This estimate concerns overall incident prostate cancer, not an aggressive subtype.
